articles.title: The LEGO Mario Minifigure Sets Look Like a Much-Needed ‘Reset’ for the Mario Theme
articles.summary: LEGO has announced its first sets based around a new group of Mario minifigures, and they look pretty great. The company has just released pictures of the boxes these sets will come in, and, uh, I kind of want these sets just for the boxes?
body: The boxes are bright and bold and colorful, all decked out in the same red and blue shades that make Mario the recognizable mascot as he is. I mean, just look at this box for the Fire Mario & Bower’s Castle set. It’s perfect.

This new line of Mario sets is something of a reset ( ba-dum-tss ) for the LEGO Mario theme. Mario and LEGO have years of history together, including plenty of awesome Nintendo LEGO sets. But the overwhelming majority of the Mario sets belonged to a play-focused LEGO Super Mario theme.

These sets were based around a big (for LEGO), boxy, non-minifigure Mario that could “interact” with the environmental elements you built. That interaction was limited to sounds and music coming out of the Mario figure, along with simple animations that played on a tiny LED screen built into his chest.

I got to try out a handful of these sets when LEGO added a boxy Luigi figure to the mix. Let’s just say they didn’t wow me. They were clearly designed for young kids, but I had young kids at the time, and they didn’t want to play with the sets for more than a couple minutes, either.
points: LEGO has announced its first sets based around a new group of Mario minifigures, and they look pretty great.
The company has just released pictures of the boxes these sets will come in, and, uh, I kind of want these sets just for the boxes?

articles.title: Playdate Manufacturer Panic Is Passing Tariff Refunds to Customers
articles.summary: Panic's Playdate, a crank-powered handheld gaming system, launched all the way back in 2022, but last year it got hit with the same tariffs as many gaming products. Now that the Supreme Court has ordered the government to refund those fees, Panic is forwarding those refunds to the customers that…
body: The company started sending out emails, spotted on LinkedIn and Reddit, informing customers that they'd be getting a tariff refund sent to their original payment method. The refund itself isn't much — the highest one I've seen is a $25 refund — but when it's attached to a handheld that costs $250 now and $179 at launch, it's a pretty decent percentage.

If you bought one of these fun little handhelds when the tariffs were active, you should be automatically getting an email notifying you of the refund. If not, you should be able to reach out to help@play.date to figure out what's going on.

Ideally, we'd see more companies refunding tariffs now that the refunds have started flowing from the governmen, but there are definitely companies that are holding on to those fees. Even Nintendo has refused to issue refunds to Switch 2 customers, arguing that gamers got exactly what they paid for. Hopefully, the Playdate manufacturers can set a decent example for other companies to follow.

articles.title: Devolver Digital Reveals Its GTA 6 Competitor, And It’s A Remaster Of A Nonexistent Remake
articles.summary: Few game companies are brave enough to go head-to-head with the release of Rockstar's Grand Theft Auto 6, but that's exactly what publisher Devolver Digital is doing with the launch of Volvy's Adventure: Reslimed on November 19.
body: Billed as a "remaster of the second remake of the original monochrome action-platformer starring the most famous video game mascot of all time," Volvy's Adventure is actually almost none of those things. The original "Volvy's Adventure" doesn't exist. This isn't a remaster but an entirely new and original game. Volvy, while actually being Devolver Digital's tongue-in-cheek platformer mascot, is obviously not the most famous of "all time."

So what is Volvy's Adventure: Reslimed, actually? It's a Game Boy Color-style 2D platformer coming to Steam from developer Doinksoft, the studio behind 2D sidescrollers like Gato Roboto and Gunbrella. Volvy himself is a rat-esque (I think?) creature with one big hand and one small hand.

Like any good platforming mascot, Volvy dashes and jumps through levels while collecting items (in this case, onions), bouncing on the heads of enemies, and battling bosses. Occasionally, Volvy transforms into a hulked out alter-ego called Swolvy capable of smashing through anything that gets in his way.

articles.title: Elden Ring Update Patch Notes Reveal Biggest Changes in Years
articles.summary: FromSoftware has delivered a surprise Elden Ring update, revealing the biggest changes its critically acclaimed action-RPG has gotten in years.
body: The developer caught fans off-guard with lengthy patch notes today, detailing a list of buffs (and a few nerfs) for different weapons and playstyles across the game. It's a major update that arrived as FromSoftware prepares for the launch of Elden Ring: Tarnished Edition for Nintendo Switch 2, as well as its accompanying DLC for other platforms.

What we have here is a laundry list of balance adjustments that get under the hood to tweak a variety of PvE and PvP tools. Based on the list of updates available on the Dark Souls developer's website, the last time we received patch notes of a similar length was back in October 2024, a few months after the Shadow of the Erdtree expansion released. That makes it not only one of the biggest updates the 2022 game-of-the-year winner has received in years, but what could be one of its final ones, too.

articles.title: Helldivers 2 Boss Happy That GTA 6 Is Skipping PC at Launch and There's No Online Right Away
articles.summary: Pretty much everyone expects the November launch of GTA 6 to dominate the world of entertainment — indeed that’s one of the reasons we have a September crush of video game releases.
body: Speaking to IGN, Arrowhead boss Shams Jorjani said that the lack of a PC version of GTA 6 at launch, as well as the absence of whatever the next generation of GTA Online looks like, means there’s reason to believe games like Helldivers 2 retain their own space.

“Rockstar makes ridiculous, high-effort stuff and it's awesome that games like this get made,” Jorjani said. “On a selfish level I'm happy it’s not hitting PC right away, and that online isn’t dropping at launch. It means Helldivers 2 gets to keep crushing it in our own space, and is also why it won’t be the all consuming behemoth everyone’s worried about.

“Everyone in the industry right now is constantly pivoting strategies and obsessing over early player feedback just to survive. But Rockstar has the brand power to confidently take their time and run their classic play. They have the confidence and freedom to spend a decade doing things the old-school way because they know the core game will deliver. It’s going to raise the bar for sure.”

articles.title: Xbox CEO Plays Coy About Whether Elder Scrolls 6 Will Skip PlayStation
articles.summary: Xbox CEO Asha Sharma has suggested Microsoft could make more exclusive games again, but will The Elder Scrolls 6 be among them? We still don't know, but that's the question the BBC asked Sharma at Gamescom this week.
body: "We are increasingly going to be one of the largest platforms in the world. Every platform needs some form of exclusive experiences and content," she said. "And so, what we've shared is Gears of War: E-Day and Clockwork [Revolution will be exclusive on console to Xbox]. We're going to do the best we can to continue to do that, all in context of the business being healthy, and so we have to balance that."

Pressed to say if it is a "priority" to make The Elder Scrolls 6 exclusive to Xbox on console, Sharma smiled and said, "It's a beautiful game." Sharma recently visited the developers at Bethesda and offered an update on how the game was progressing. During her visit, protestors came to Bethesda's offices to drag Sharma for her decision to lay off thousands of Xbox developers, including people working on The Elder Scrolls 6.
Due to these layoffs and other cuts, staffers at Bethesda are facing "crushing morale" and fears of more delays.

articles.title: The Most Expensive Xbox Ever Sold Out, And People Are Already Flipping It For Thousands
articles.summary: Microsoft opened up preorders for its limited-edition 25th-Anniversary Xbox Series X, and within a minute, the most expensive Xbox ever sold out. While units will likely make their ways into the hands of Xbox fans with deep pockets, it looks like scalpers have also snatched up units, and as you'd…
body: A quick look at the commerce platform reveals dozens of the rare Xbox Series X consoles have been listed, with prices ranging from $2,200 all the way up to an incredibly optimistic $27,426 by one seller in Australia--likely as a way to grab the top spot on eBay's search page. Microsoft opened up preorders with a $900 asking price for the console, so this is quite the jump. So far, it looks like quite a few of the consoles have been sold at the marked-up price, with several sales on eBay averaging between $1,900 to $2,300 per unit sold.

This is also an unpleasant reminder of the early years of the current console generation, as thanks to a semiconductor shortage, the Xbox Series X and the PS5 were hard to find. Scalpers using a variety of methods and programs were quick to snatch up restocks online and resold them, but supply chains eventually stabilized and access to the current console generation was easier--at least until a variety of factors saw their prices surge upwards last year, with no sign of relief in the immediate future.

articles.title: 'Forza Horizon 6' Reportedly Delayed for PS5 as Console Wars Heat Up
articles.summary: After a brief armistice, the console wars are back on. Despite an earlier announcement that Xbox's Forza Horizon 6 would come to PlayStation 5 sometime this year, it seems the port has been quietly delayed. The Verge’s Tom Warren wrote as much on X, with IGN affirming the claim.
body: Forza Horizon 6 ’s 2026 release window for PS5 was announced shortly before the game came out on PC and Xbox Series X|S to glowing praise. However, things have changed at Xbox since earlier this year. Asha Sharma took over as Xbox Game Division CEO back in February, while several members of executive leadership left the company. Sharma later announced that Xbox would be undergoing a major “reset” to address its recent financial struggles. This culminated in a July announcement that 3,200 employees would be laid off over the next fiscal quarter and that Microsoft would be cutting ties with several of its studios.

Around the same time, Microsoft began to deemphasize publishing its games on rival platforms. While Halo: Campaign Evolved was released on PlayStation 5, Xbox reportedly pulled the game's trailer from one of Sony's State of Play broadcasts. Xbox also reportedly killed a mostly complete PS5 port of Gears of War: E-Day shortly before its reveal.
points: After a brief armistice, the console wars are back on.

articles.title: Germany’s President Warns Of Downsides To Gaming, Including Games With “Extremist Ideologies”
articles.summary: This year's Gamescom event is underway in Cologne, Germany, and now the country's president, Frank-Walter Steinmeier--speaking at the event itself--warned people to consider the downsides to gaming. He also said gaming is great and has lots of positive effects on people and society.
body: As reported by DPA International, he said video games have "become so ubiquitous," so it's only prudent to "discuss the downsides of this development." He said people should look at video games "objectively, honestly, and in a nuanced way."

Steinmeier pointed out how the World Health Organization has warned of the dangers of gaming addiction, and he went on to say some video games expose people to "brutality and raw violence, to sexism, racism, inhuman thinking, and extremist ideologies."

Also during his speech, Steinmeier said it's an outdated way of thinking to believe a "gamer" is someone who plays video games 24/7, eats junk food, and drinks energy drinks in a dark room. This "does not do justice to reality," he said.

"Games have long since found their place at the heart of our society," he said, adding that advancements to gaming technology have helped various other industries, including medicine, architecture, and motor vehicle design.

articles.title: Magic’s Most Expensive Banned Card Is Officially Coming Back, but There’s a Catch
articles.summary: Official previews for Magic: The Gathering ’s upcoming Reality Fracture don't begin until Sept. 8, but fans of the world’s oldest trading card game know principal designer Mark Rosewater ’s early teases mark (pun intended) the real start of preview season.
body: Rosewater offered a total of 40 hints as snippets of rules text, creature type lines, and card names. Some of the most intriguing teases suggest that Reality Fracture will feature an instant players can include any number of copies of in their decks, a new cycle of dual lands with a new restriction determining whether they enter tapped, and a mechanic that creates a type of token no other mechanic has ever produced.

Based on these hints, it’s clear that Reality Fracture has a lot of emphasis on planeswalkers — which is something we already knew from previous announcements at MagicCon: Las Vegas and Amsterdam. One card will allow a planeswalker to deal damage equal to its loyalty. Another prevents planeswalkers from being put into their owners’ graveyards when they hit zero loyalty. Reality Fracture is the end of an ongoing saga, so many of Magic ’s most prominent planeswalkers and legendary creatures will appear, alongside their Echoverse counterparts from the alternate universe that the misguided mind mage Jace Beleren has created.

articles.summary: Bosses are strong NPCs that you can challenge to a fight Fortnite Chapter 7 Season 4. After you defeat a boss, they'll drop powerful loot like mythic weapons. In past seasons, bosses would spawn at multiple locations around the map, but in this season, they can be found at locations that are a…
body: In Chapter 7 Season 4, there are currently two bosses: Dr. Eggman and Hush. Here's where you can find Dr. Eggman, Hush, and all the bosses in Fortnite Chapter 7 Season 4.

Dr. Eggman and Hush are the two bosses for Fortnite Chapter 7 Season 4, and they'll both spawn at the start of the game. These bosses have fairly limited spawn locations, so it won't take long for players to hunt them down to get mythic weapons or complete weekly quests. Below, we've listed every boss' spawn location along with their drops.

If you're trying to defeat a boss to complete the weekly quest, make sure to drop into their respective areas to defeat them first. We recommend going for Hush as they can be easily defeated if you keep your distance. They'll continuously run in your direction if you're far away enough, which will give you ample time to eliminate them before they can do any damage to you.

articles.title: GTA 6 Netflix extended look live report - all the gameplay and revelations from Rockstar's Grand Theft Auto 6 premiere
articles.summary: Tonight we'll get probably our best look at Grand Theft Auto 6 yet, as Rockstar's 'extended look' trailer airs exclusively on Netflix. We'll be watching it live and reporting on everything we see, here, in this article.
body: What are we expecting to see? Gameplay, ideally. We've had two official trailers show us montages of action across Leonidas (the game's version of Florida), but we haven't yet seen - officially - what it's like to play the game. Unofficially, of course, we have: days of GTA 6 gameplay video leaks have given us a pretty broad idea of what to expect. But this trailer ought to provide a much more authored and considered look.

We're expecting to see more of the dual protagonists Lucia and Jason and the reportedly "seamless" switching between them as they explore; more of the San Andreas-like role-playing systems in the game around exercising and eating; and more of the staggering level of detail and realism Rockstar's army of developers has created.
We're not sure how long the GTA 6 extended look trailer will be, incidentally, but we expect it to be fairly substantial given the pomp around a Netflix premiere.

articles.title: Elden Ring Fans Just Got a Major Reason to Come Back to the Game
articles.summary: Elden Ring Tarnished Edition, which bundles the base game and its excellent Shadow of the Erdtree DLC alongside some new additions, is finally coming to Nintendo Switch 2 this week.
body: Tarnished Edition includes two new starting classes, new weapons that can be found or purchased from merchants, and three new attire options for the spectral steed Torrent. Other additions include new invasion events in Caelid and Leyndell, including one where a devout, mostly naked man attacks you with a flail. The DLC will be available on all systems on Aug. 28, the same day the Switch 2 releases.

One of the biggest potential changes is that parries have been enhanced across the board, with “improved parry performance.” Presumably, this means a larger parry window or faster activation. There were also a handful of PvP nerfs where Rakshasa’s Great Katana got hit again, as well as a few incantations.

The critical response to Elden Ring Tarnished Edition on the Switch 2 has been quite positive, with critics impressed by how well the game runs on the handheld. This version was originally planned for 2025 but was delayed so the team could optimize the game’s performance after a rough showing at last year's Gamescom.
The full patch notes for Elden Ring version 1.17 can be found below.

articles.summary: After years of speculation and rumors, Rockstar is finally giving us a deeper official look at Grand Theft Auto 6. (Unlike the various unofficial looks we've been getting courtesy of a certain vegetable.) The GTA 6 "Extended Look" airs Thursday, August 27 on Netflix at 12 pm PDT/3 pm EDT/8 pm BST.
body: Rockstar has not said exactly what the video will entail, but we're assuming we'll see a good amount of gameplay and find out more about our two lead characters, Lucia and Jason. We'll be responding live to the reveal in the blog feed below, cataloging all the details and sharing reactions from around the web.

GTA 6 is due out on consoles on November 19. There's frustratingly still no PC release date, and Rockstar is unlikely to speak on that anytime soon. Perhaps we'll at least hear something about GTA Online, which has been conspicuously absent from the conversation so far.
Ahead of the official GTA 6 reveal, someone who goes by "Cyberleek" has been releasing gameplay clips that apparently come from a build of the game they have continuous access to.

I assume there's a control room somewhere in which suited lawyers are pointing at giant maps and saying "enhance," but Rockstar hasn't tracked down the leaker yet, and in the meantime, we've learned a lot about GTA 6's gameplay.

articles.title: Manor Lords celebrates 4 million copies sold with a new major update which gives players the chance to become 'a cow-herding mogul'
articles.summary: Manor Lords is on a roll—with the medieval management sim celebrating the monumental milestone of over 4 million copies sold across all stores. And to commemorate the good news comes its next major update.
body: The new Major Update 8 will add a bunch of new features and quality-of-life bumps to Manor Lords. Soon you'll be able to use apples to make cider, honey to make mead, and thresh easy-to-grow oats so you can feed both humans and livestock.

Speaking of, there's also the chance for players to become "a cow-herding mogul with the ability to breed and import bovine livestock" alongside the new benefit of being able to make little barns for your sheep to help them last through the cold winter months.

As an accomplished Manor Lords sheep farmer, this is music to my ears. I love my sheep more than I love the townsfolk I'm stuck with, so I'll gladly take advantage of any way to make their wooly lives a bit warmer and a lot more comfortable.

Other features include welcoming cheesemongers to the hamlet, who will "form the basis of a future cheese-related perk" (I'm going to start trading in charcuterie—just watch me). Alongside a new river map which is known as Wide Valley, "a verdant region ripe for lording over".

videos.summary: The first (official) gameplay details for Grand Theft Auto 6 have been revealed, and if you're a fan of GTA San Andreas, you'll feel right at home in the latest entry.
body: Presented by Universal Orlando Resort, and its newest theme park, Universal Epic Universe.
points: The first (official) gameplay details for Grand Theft Auto 6 have been revealed, and if you're a fan of GTA San Andreas, you'll feel right at home in the latest entry.
RPG-like mechanics for sleep, eating, exercise, and more will be making a return in GTA 6, and they will have a visible effect on your character.
More will be announced when the game gets its first gameplay deep dive on Netflix later today.
And XBOX CEO Asha Sharma touched how the upcoming Project Helix console will handle the physical games question.
videos.author: IGN

videos.title: Son Of Thanjai - Release Window Trailer | Xbox @ gamescom 2026
videos.summary: The Chola empire is dying from the inside. As the prince, cast out onto the streets, you must reclaim what is yours and discover what it means to be king. "Can a kingdom be saved by its worst son?" Son of Thanjai comes to Xbox Series X/S, PC, Cloud, and Game Pass in Spring 2027.

videos.title: Fable - A New Look At Combat
videos.summary: Fable is playable for the press and content creators at Gamescom, and here's some of the combat encounters players will run into during the demo. This is from a mission called Mud and Death. The player character is fighting alongside a man named Humphry in an abandoned mine.
